description: Scan all blocks in the cuboid between two corners (inclusive) and return their ids. Regions above 16,777,216 positions (e.g. 256x256x256) are refused to protect the server: split larger areas. The answer is capped at maxBlocks (default 32768, truncated=true when hit); air is omitted unless includeAir is true. With includeState each block also has 'state', the id with its properties (facing, half, open, ...), to check that what was built faces the right way.

dimension.description: Dimension id, e.g. "minecraft:overworld", "minecraft:the_nether". Defaults to the current/overworld dimension.

includeAir.description: Include air blocks in the result.

includeState.description: Add each block's full state, e.g. "minecraft:oak_stairs[facing=east,half=bottom,shape=straight,waterlogged=false]".

name: get_blocks_region
title: Scan a cuboid region
